description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcels in Dambulla,  Mallawapitiya  and Galewela D/S Divisions
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title settlement procedures, and determinations of land titles - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
